# The PHP-window fixtures: expected results

Two fixtures for the PHP window (T-M5-01, `docs/concepts/php-and-core-target.md`). Their goldens are
`tests/golden/php-window/` (the `php-target.sh` scans, regenerated by `tests/unit/php_window_golden.sh`) and the lab
recordings of their `php -l` legs in `tests/fixtures/{php_window,d11_php_only}.golden/`.

## `php_window`

A Drupal 10-era module (`^10.3 || ^11`) whose code meets the edges of the window.

| Construct | File | Rule (`config/php/rules.json`) | Window 8.1..8.4 (`^10.3 \|\| ^11`, P 8.4) | Window 8.3..8.5 (`^11.3 \|\| ^12`, P 8.5) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string $prefix = NULL` (an implicitly nullable parameter) | `src/Connection.php` | `p84-implicit-nullable` | `apply-compat` (the compat pass, ADR 0002); `php -l` 8.4 reports it | `apply-compat`; `php -l` 8.4 and 8.5 report it |
| `(integer)` cast | `php_window.module` | `p85-cast-names` | `not-applicable` | `report-only`, found by the scan (`fix_at_floor`: `(int)` runs anywhere, so the item's reason is `deprecated-no-rule`); `php -l` 8.5 reports it |
| `\PDO::MYSQL_ATTR_INIT_COMMAND` | `src/Connection.php` | `p85-pdo-mysql-constants` | `not-applicable` | `report-only`, found by the scan (`Pdo\Mysql` is PHP 8.4: below a floor of 8.4 the reason is `fix-needs-php-above-floor`, from 8.4 `deprecated-no-rule`) |
| `__sleep()` in a `DependencySerializationTrait` class | `src/CachedLookup.php` | `deny-sleep-to-serialize` | `deny` (never run) | `deny` |
| `array_find()` (PHP 8.4) | `php_window.module` | none yet | not detected: the polyfill intersection (T-M5-04) and the rule audit that fills `apply-modernize` (T-M5-03) arrive later | the same |

Every `php -l` leg compiles (status `pass`): no construct of the fixture is removed in its windows.

The two windows above are the goldens' explicit bounds. The plan the port computes today has the floor 8.4 for
both: `detect-php-floor.sh` counts `array_find()` as PHP 8.4 code and is not yet aware of the polyfills core ships
(T-M5-04, T-M5-08). Lab L-M5-1 (2026-10-12, bed `dpl-m4-legwid-d11`, core 11.4.8): at P 8.4 the window is `8.4`,
Rector's php84 level set makes the parameter explicitly nullable, and nothing is left for a person; at P 8.5 the
window is `8.4, 8.5` and the cast and the PDO constant are two non-blocking `human` items.

## `d11_php_only`

A Drupal 11 module (`^11.3`, S = T = 11: the plan has no hop, so the stage `upgrade` is skipped `same-major`) that
only needs PHP work, with the target PHP 8.5 (W = 8.3..8.5).

| Construct | File | Rule | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `each($list)` | `d11_php_only.module` | `removed-each` (removed in PHP 8.0) | `removed-blocking`: a blocking `human` item, reason `removed-in-target-php`; once ported, `port-summary.sh --strict` exits 3. `php -l` compiles it (the call fails only at run time) |
| `string $name = NULL` | `src/Greeter.php` | `p84-implicit-nullable` | `apply-compat`; `php -l` 8.4 and 8.5 report it |
